integrity: The proof derives an n-1 lower bound from same-side vertex distinguishability, classifies every equality transversal by explicit vertex-edge distance vectors, and then isolates the domination obstruction. A standalone checker independently reconstructs distances, mixed representations, and domination.
scientific_limitations: The complete minimum-set classification and count are stated only for n at least seven.
The dominant mixed metric dimension is determined for all crown graphs with n at least three, but transition-case minimum sets are not enumerated.
Unbalanced complete bipartite graphs with a matching deleted and partial matching deletions are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification through n=9 is corroborative only; the theorem is proved symbolically.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed crown-graph treatment.
title: Dominant mixed metric dimension of crown graphs
